# Tickets

A ticket reports a problem to the platform owner: a bug, a missing capability, a refusal that looks wrong, a docs gap. The `report_issue` tool files one in a single call (it wraps `ticket.create`); `ticket.list` and the `tickets` resource read your own tickets on this site with their status and the owner's close note. Nothing on the site changes. See the `libretto-report-issue` skill for when to file one.

[`ticket.create`](#ticketcreate) · [`ticket.list`](#ticketlist)

## ticket.create

Report a problem to the platform owner: a bug, a missing capability, a refusal that looks wrong (category `refusal`), a docs gap, anything that blocks the person you work for. Write the title as one line and the body in Markdown (what you were doing, for whom, what blocked you); add `steps`, `expected` and `actual` (paste the error code and message) when you have them, the `requestId` of the failing batch and the `pageId` it was on. `severity` `blocking` means the person cannot go on. The platform owner reads it in the admin and answers by closing it with a note, which ticket.list shows. It is not site content: it writes no document, has no undo and must run alone in a batch, not as a dry run; the MCP tool report_issue does the same in one call. At most 20 tickets an hour per person (429 ticket_rate_limited); a pageId that is not a page of this site is 422 ticket_page_unknown.

- permission `ticket.report` (admin, editor, content); class `external`; writes nothing; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 160) | yes |
| `body` | string (min 1, max 20000) | yes |
| `category` | "bug" \| "missing-capability" \| "refusal" \| "docs" \| "other" | yes |
| `severity` | "low" \| "medium" \| "high" \| "blocking" |  |
| `pageId` | string (min 1, max 36) |  |
| `steps` | string (min 1, max 5000) |  |
| `expected` | string (min 1, max 5000) |  |
| `actual` | string (min 1, max 5000) |  |
| `requestId` | uuid |  |

Output: { ticket: { id: uuid, status: "open" \| "triaged" \| "closed", title: string, body: string, category: "bug" \| "missing-capability" \| "refusal" \| "docs" \| "other", severity: "low" \| "medium" \| "high" \| "blocking", steps: string \| null, expected: string \| null, actual: string \| null, requestId: string \| null, pageId: strin… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"title":"tree.commit refuses a hover colour on a button label","body":"Setting the hover colour of a `ds.button` label through `p:label|s::hover` is refused, although the inspector sets it.","category":"refusal","severity":"high","pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","actual":"422 tree_invalid I8","requestId":"0b7c6d5e-4f3a-4b2c-8d1e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"}
```

> Prefer the `report_issue` tool: the same input, one call, no batch. Through `apply_ops` it must be alone in its batch, with `baseRevisions` `{}`, and cannot be dry-run. 429 `ticket_rate_limited` after 20 tickets in an hour; 422 `ticket_page_unknown` for a `pageId` that is not a page of this site.

## ticket.list

List the tickets you reported on this site, newest first (at most 100), optionally only those with a status: open, triaged (the platform owner has seen it) or closed (with the platform owner's closeNote).

- permission `ticket.report` (admin, editor, content); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | "open" \| "triaged" \| "closed" |  |

Output: { tickets: ({ id: uuid, status: "open" \| "triaged" \| "closed", title: string, body: string, category: "bug" \| "missing-capability" \| "refusal" \| "docs" \| "other", severity: "low" \| "medium" \| "high" \| "blocking", steps: string \| null, expected: string \| null, actual: string \| null, requestId: string \| null, pageId: str… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"status":"open"}
```

> Your own tickets on this site, newest first, with `status` and the owner's `closeNote`; the `tickets` resource answers the same. Read it before filing, so as not to report the same problem twice.
